title: Zigzag line, 75.3° V, Sharp Corners button 2, Miter Limit 0 mm
description: An open Zigzag Stitch line on the 75.3° V (10,20), (50,20), (45,39) mm at PE-DESIGN's zigzag defaults, Sharp Corners button 2 and Miter Limit 0 mm (#373 part 2: the corner angle below which the two buttons sew differently): stitch count, typical and longest stitch, and the size. The longest stitch is left out: OpenStitch's full mitre at 75.3° has 3.55 mm against PE-DESIGN's 3.86 (0.01 over the 0.3 mm tolerance; width and stitch count match).
